name: @mp-consulting/homebridge-govee
description: Homebridge plugin to integrate Govee devices into HomeKit.
author: MP Consulting

scripts.watch: npm run build && npm link && nodemon
scripts.copy:ui-assets: mkdir -p homebridge-ui/public/lib/fonts && cp node_modules/@mp-consulting/homebridge-ui-kit/dist/kit.css node_modules/@mp-consulting/homebridge-ui-kit/dist/kit.js homebridge-ui/public/lib/ && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/bootstrap-icons.min.css homebridge-ui/public/lib/ && cp node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/bootstrap-icons.woff node_modules/bootstrap-icons/font/fonts/bootstrap-icons.woff2 homebridge-ui/public/lib/fonts/
scripts.build: npm run copy:ui-assets && rimraf ./dist && tsc && cp -r src/connection/cert dist/connection/ && cp src/catalog/scene-library.json dist/catalog/ && node scripts/generate-ui-models.js
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run build
